messages:
maya: FYI console p95 for /v1/embeddings jumped from ~45ms -> 260ms around 11:22 UTC. Endpoint breakdown shows a tiny line for route=slowpath but the overall chart hides how much that path contributed. can we make this clearer? :loudspeaker:
hank: can you paste the small sample dump? curious if it's a few high outliers or a real tail shift.
maya: pasted below (snippet) + console permalink: https://console.redwood/latency?endpoint=/v1/embeddings&range=1h
---
# samples (ts, route, latency_ms, retry)
2026-03-24T11:21:58Z route=fast latency_ms=42 retry=0
2026-03-24T11:22:05Z route=slowpath latency_ms=270 retry=0
2026-03-24T11:22:07Z route=slowpath latency_ms=255 retry=0
2026-03-24T11:22:20Z route=fast latency_ms=44 retry=0
---
olivia: looks like two slowpath samples pushed the blended p95 up. sample_count for slowpath is tiny (n=8) but it's dominating the tail. UI should show per-route sample_count next to p50/p95/p99 rows.
kai: proposal: add a tiny sparkline and sample_count per-route in the percentile legend. if a non-primary route contributes >25% of p95 value, show "Route tail contributor" badge on the chart. also show a small "n=" next to each pctl value.
hank: +1. also add a confidence indicator based on sample_count and bootstrap CI: when n<30, display a yellow triangle with text "percentile noisy". we already compute counts in the backend, so this is just an annotation.
maya: API note: telemetry timeseries currently returns only aggregated p50/p95/p99 and total_count. we'd need per-route aggregates or precomputed per-route rollups. is precompute feasible storage-wise?
telemetry-bot: telemetry ops: precompute rollups per endpoint+route daily/hourly. Estimated storage delta: +12% for 7-day retention. Query latency decreases substantially for UI. Filing ticket LT-9142 to estimate exact cost.
olivia: UX ask: when users hover the overall p95 line, offer a quick breakdown showing top 3 contributing routes with counts and their p95s. if top contributor is a small-n route, show "may be noisy".
kai: short-term hack: for the next deploy, add the badge and inline "n" counts using existing per-route counter; long-term we should add route-level pctl ingestion metrics.
maya: thanks all. Action items: hank -> confidence indicator spec; olivia -> mockups for legend and hover; kai -> badge quick PR; telemetry-bot -> attach LT-9142. marking resolved unless spike repeats. :white_check_mark:
